notes.title: Update v1.5.1.5
notes.notes:
Helllo! We ran into a few hiccups getting 1.5 content out on all consoles (all fixed now! They're on their way!), but in the meantime, we've got a few minor fixes to share!

As per the console fixes, this version will no longer have controller-players ending up off the map during the 1.5 content (easily fixed with a reposition, but still, better not to happen at all!), in addition to a few fixes that players have recently reported. Thanks!

Improvements & Fixes

• When playing with a controller, the squad should no longer fall off the map following the first epilogue behemoth fight, requiring a reposition.
• Fixed a localization issue regarding the Diplomacy Module in a few different languages.
• Dark Paragon Perk names have now been fixed.
• Fixed an issue where the Guardian's attacks couldn't be hastened through equipment
• Also fixed an issue where, when combined with the Empath's Inspire power, the Guardian would gain two instant powers back-to-back.


Bug Reporting

If you are running into issues, you can submit a bug report here:
www.rawfury.com/support

Extra things that will help us fix these pesky bugs:
- Screenshots
- Detailed step by step instructions on how to reproduce the bug
- Your save files (PC only) using CTRL-F12 before or at the moment the bug has occurred. Doing so will create a folder on your desktop called "SR_Bug_Report" that contains your save files and output logs which we can then use to debug the issue.


Thanks for your support!
- The Massive Damage Team

notes.title: The Prime Dimension - Free Content Update!
notes.notes:
Alright, Renegades it's go-time! We've got you a one-way ticket to the so-called “Prime Dimension” -- the epicenter of the Imperium and the source of their invasions. Who knows what you’ll face on the other side, but I’ve got a feeling it ain’t going to go down without a fight. So, what are you waiting for, grub-worms?!? Gear up, lock and load, and tell J5 to tuck away his marshmallow kit because things are about to get serious!

[previewyoutube=j0jN9V1iSrE;full][/previewyoutube]

As a special gift to you legacy players, we've got a new batch of content specifically for those of you who have beaten the game a bunch of times!  In addition, there's also a long-requested feature: being able to recruit Progeny mid-run.

NOTE: There are a few instances of dialogue within the 1.5 content from the heroes, but you won't see them if you have "Suppress Idle Banter" option enabled. The content works fine without them chiming in, of course, but you may wish to disable that option when pursuing the 1.5 content for the first time.

Improvements & Fixes

• New secret ending specifically for legacy players!
• This includes new music as well!
• Finish the game with a squad made up ENTIRELY of heroes whose overseer counterparts have been defeated, and you'll have the chance to enter the Imperium home dimension and bring the fight to them!
• By successfully defeating the Imperium in their home dimension, you'll unlock a special hero: the Dark Paragon
• For this purpose, you'll notice new insignias on the Squad Selection Screen and recruitment screens indicating who has and hasn't had their overseer counterpart defeated.
• To do this, you first need to help Professor Zurek decode a mysterious new Imperium Dimension transmission by securing Imperium cryptography devices. To find out more, you'll just need to play!
• Also, mid-run hero recruitment has been opened up to progeny as well!
• Fixed Marksman/Spectre Camaraderie Dialogue (was triggering Gunslinger/Spectre dialogue).
• Added a catch to fix a rare issue where the moon teleporter wouldn't deactivate upon re-entering main map.
• One of the Dagan Factory dungeons had interactables floating above the floor. That's now fixed.
• Squad selection panel is now wider to accommodate extra hero.

Bug Reporting

If you are running into issues, you can submit a bug report here:
www.rawfury.com/support

Extra things that will help us fix these pesky bugs:

- Detailed step by step instructions on how to reproduce the bug

notes.title: Patch v1.0.2.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32326506/e2fd0fd4de8f4865909fa2846d5a059874aff278.png
Hey Renegades! Here's our second quality of life update along with some balance changes. We've given the Paragon, Juggernaut, and the Overseers some love along with some much needed balancing to some effects from Gear that were just too powerful, especially when stacked together. We hope that you feel the changes are fair and if you think otherwise, please feel free to give us some feedback on our Steam Forums or Discord server!

In addition, if you're a diehard fan who "likes the way it used to be", we're opening up additional Beta branches so that you can play on older major versions. However, we would HIGHLY recommend backing up your save files before playing with these builds as switching back and forth between versions can be unstable and we don't want anything to happen to your save files. A quick and easy way to do that is to hit CTRL-F12 from the Title Screen and it'll copy all your save files to your desktop into a folder called "SR_Bug_Report". To restore these files, simply paste them in to your Documents/Star Renegades folder.


Patch Notes
Improvements & Fixes
• New EASY difficulty mode
• More map optimizations on Menku and Dagan's Factory map
• (Mouse controls) When in Inspect Mode, you now need to LMB click on a unit to switch to them and HOLD the LMB on a hero unit to cancel it's queued action
• You can now view Effects on equipment from the Rewards, Merchant, and Inventory screens
• Debuff effects no longer stack with lower version effects of the same debuff; only the strongest version of the effect will be applied (except Bleeding which will still stack)
• Fixed some localization issues
• Fixed Varangian / Spectre, Varangian / Gunslinger, Marksman / Enforcer combos
• Changed Conduit power name to Absorb and can't target herself
• Fixed issue with Dagan Factory not having properly scaled rewards
• Fixed issue with powers displaying the same effect twice
• Fixed issue with Enforcer and Gunslinger heals not being affected by Regen Shields+ Gear
• Fixed issue with stealth not always redirecting attacks
• Fixed issue with drones getting promoted when they shouldn't be allowed
• Fixed issue with Valkyrie Guardian hero perk not enabling Defend on Battlecry
• Fixed issue with Imperium Cruiser softlocking on entry
• Fixed issue with Kellin Syphex's Groundstab causing softlocks (no longer Defends on use)
• Fixed issue with Medkits being usable more than once
• Fixed achievement for unlocking hero perks
• Fixed achievement for unlocking progeny
• Fixed damage trait mixup between Desecrator (no longer does extra damage) and Debilitator (now has extra damage)
• Reduced "Hold to Execute / Skip / Cancel" action timing by 25%

Balance
• Reduced Herald and all Overseers stagger limit increase per action by 1
• Overseers now summon faster
• Dramatically reduced effectiveness of Weaken Stagger Defense (max -50%), Chilled (max 25s slow), and Rattled effects (max -50%)
• Reduced max enemy Stagger Limit from 9 to 6
• Paragon's Bladethrow now does 2 Armor Damage per hit and is 5s faster. Siphon Stab is also 5s faster while Tempest is 10s slower.
• Rampart combo power now has Defend effect and increased reflect damage to 75%
• Reduced armor damage for Juggernaut's Punch but increased for Rule of Law 's armor damage
• Increased damage for Juggernaut's Crowd Control and Rule of Law
• Juggernaut's Battering Ram->Conduit effect now distributes Shields to all allies when she is hit
